correctness.rationale: For every finite lambda, the degree cutoff f(n)=n+floor(exp(lambda*n)-1) is increasing and superadditive, so it defines a finite-dimensional exhaustive algebra filtration of \(k[x]\). Its successive quotient dimension is asymptotic to (exp(lambda)-1)exp(lambda*(n-1)), giving entropy lambda. The standard degree filtration gives zero, and replacing the exponential by \(e^{n^2}\) gives infinite entropy. Thus the extended nonnegative spectrum is exactly \([0,\infty]\).
